---
title: syntax-highlighting key (Quarto 1's current name)
format:
  html:
    syntax-highlighting: github
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      noErrorsOrWarnings: true
      ensureCssRegexMatches:
        # github-light's keyword red reaches the stylesheet (GH #1035:
        # the HTML parser used to read only the deprecated
        # `highlight-style:` alias and fell back to the default palette).
        - ["\\.hl-keyword", "#d73a49"]
        # No fallback to the default palette's solarized keyword green.
        - ["#859900"]
---

`syntax-highlighting:` is Quarto 1's current name for the palette option;
`highlight-style:` is its deprecated alias. Both select the HTML palette,
and `syntax-highlighting:` wins when both are set.

```python
def hello():
    print("Hello, World!")
```
